topics.name: Numbers 1-20
topics.learning_outcome: Students can identify, count, and write numbers 1-20.

content.hindi: आज हम संख्याओं 1 से 20 तक सीखेंगे।
content.santhali: ᱮᱢᱟᱡᱮ ᱫᱟᱨᱤ ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ 1 ᱠᱚᱨᱟ 20 ᱦᱟᱨᱮ ᱵᱟᱝᱨᱚᱢ ᱢᱮ।

topics.name: Addition
topics.learning_outcome: Students can perform simple addition within 20.

topics.name: Subtraction
topics.learning_outcome: Students can perform simple subtraction within 20.

content.hindi: आज हम वस्तुओं की गिनती करेंगे।
content.santhali: ᱮᱢᱟᱡᱮ ᱫᱟᱨᱤ ᱵᱤᱥᱩᱨᱤ ᱜᱤᱱᱚᱨᱮ ᱵᱟᱝᱨᱚᱢ ᱢᱮ।

topics.name: Shapes
topics.learning_outcome: Students can identify and name basic shapes.

topics.name: Letters
topics.learning_outcome: Students can recognize Devanagari and Ol Chiki letters.

topics.name: Story Reading
topics.learning_outcome: Students can read and understand simple stories.

content.santhali: ᱮᱢᱟᱡᱮ ᱫᱟᱨᱤ ᱤᱧ ᱝᱚᱞᱚᱨ ᱛᱟᱢᱮᱨᱚᱜ ᱢᱮ।
